statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), count actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets once by their vertex sets, and put d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle. Suppose R=227, every d_T belongs to {0,1,2}, and exactly five actual triangles have deficiency two. Suppose every vertex used by the deficiency-one triangles lies in exactly two of them; let S be their support. It is impossible that exactly two outside-S vertices lie in deficiency-two triangles.
